note: Seed response to light, not image-forming vision. Light: five samples of 20 seeds; darkness: one sample of 100 seeds. Temperature is the only tested or the optimal regime, depending on seed availability. Germination percentages and conditions are transcribed; seed mass and derived PGI indices are not separate sensory measurements.

method: Seed germination assay; viability-corrected final germination
conditions: constant temperature 25 °C; continuous darkness; provenance Greece

note: Seed response to light, not image-forming vision. Light: five samples of 20 seeds; darkness: one sample of 100 seeds. Temperature is the only tested or the optimal regime, depending on seed availability. Germination percentages and conditions are transcribed; seed mass and derived PGI indices are not separate sensory measurements.

method: Seed germination assay; viability-corrected final germination
conditions: constant temperature 15 °C; continuous darkness; provenance USA
